text_description: Full runway look centered on a sleeveless black top worn over a voluminous pleated midi skirt. The top has a rounded neckline and close, slightly tunic-like fit through the torso, with an irregular asymmetric hem falling lower over one hip; its surface is decorated with playful graphic embellishments including white dotted curving lines, a red-and-white circular motif near the upper chest, small yellow details, and a sketch-like yellow-green motif near the lower side. Beneath it, the skirt dominates the silhouette: a high-volume A-line shape with dense vertical accordion pleats in alternating black, ivory, tan, and golden stripes, creating strong movement and texture. The hem is layered and uneven, finished with a wide band of pale straw-gold fringe or tassel-like trim, with darker black fringed or lace-like texture visible below, giving the lower edge a fluttering, artisanal effect. Styling includes a dark textured shoulder bag tucked under one arm and a second tan/black patterned soft bag or accessory visible at the opposite side. The footwear is a pointed-toe heeled pump with narrow black-and-white striping and slim ankle/instep straps, matching the graphic linear quality of the skirt. The overall mood is playful, crafted, and highly textured, mixing graphic embellishment with striped pleats and fringed movement.
